fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合内向、玻璃心、受不了被拒绝的人。这行每天面对大量拒绝，情绪崩得快的人干不长；不爱说话、怕打电话的人也做不了。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径：不限专业 → 呼叫中心或销售团队从话务员做起 → 熟练话术与客户分层 → 转电销主管或升 B2B 销售、大客户销售；优秀的电销往往转向面销、渠道或销售运营。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合脸皮厚、嘴皮快、抗挫力强的人。被挂断一百次还能笑着打第一百零一次；声音要有感染力，逻辑要清楚，还得有把「不需要」聊成「再了解下」的本事。

personality_fit_block.callout: 脸皮厚、口才好、又扛得住打击的人，电销是练沟通和销售的最快道场。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 抗挫力：被拒绝是家常便饭
表达力：声音有感染力、逻辑清楚
同理心：听得出客户的潜台词

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is simultaneous pressure from industry relocation and automation. Without learning new equipment, workers face replacement by both cheaper labor and more intelligent machines.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: It does not suit people who cannot stay active, dislike noise and dust, or hate shift work. Three-shift schedules are common, and a full day of standing and machine patrol leaves legs and feet sore. People seeking quiet office work will not stay long.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: textile factory apprentice or machine tender → start in winding, twisting, or another basic process → learn machine adjustment, yarn changes, and quality sampling → advance to equipment maintenance, repair, or team leadership, or transition to automated production-line operation.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This work suits quick-handed, attentive people who tolerate workshop conditions. If you can join broken ends rapidly, repeat motions all day without frustration, and work comfortably with machinery, you can succeed in this field.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you accept workshop noise and shifts and continue advancing with automation, this field will not offer high pay but can provide stable, dependable work.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Hand-eye coordination: Join ends and change yarn quickly and accurately
Attention to detail: Yarn quality hides in small details
Procedural compliance: Follow safety and process discipline
Noise tolerance and endurance: Handle workshop conditions

boundary_notice: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「行业转移 + 自动化」双线挤压——不学新设备，就会被更便宜的人工和更聪明的机器同时淘汰。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合坐不住、受不了噪声和粉尘、讨厌倒班的人。车间三班倒是常态，站着巡机一天下来腿脚都酸，想「安静办公」的人在这里待不久。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：进纺织厂做学徒/挡车工 → 从络筒、捻线等基础工序干起 → 学会调机、换纱、质量抽检 → 向保全工、设备维修或班组长方向发展，或转向自动化产线操作。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合手快、心细、受得了车间环境的人。你眼疾手快能接断头，一整天重复动作也不烦，能跟机器和睦相处，这行就干得下去。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你能接受车间的轰鸣与倒班，又能跟着自动化把技能往上走，这行给不了高薪，但能给你一份稳定的踏实。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 手眼协调：接头、换纱要快而准
细心：纱线质量藏在小细节里
服从规程：安全与工艺纪律
抗噪耐劳：车间环境的承受力

boundary_notice: The greatest risk in watch repair is not AI, but the long training period + a shrinking low-end market. Craftspeople who endure the solitude and master complex movements become increasingly scarce and valuable.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: It does not suit people with shaky hands, a careless temperament, or severe uncorrected nearsightedness. Searching half a day for a dropped part is common; people who hate wrestling with tiny objects find this work deeply frustrating.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: learn the basics at a watch-repair training institution or through an apprenticeship → practice through cleaning and routine maintenance → specialize in quartz watches and common movement repairs → advance to complex mechanical movements and antique restoration → join an authorized brand service center or open an independent repair shop.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This occupation suits steady-handed, meticulous, patient people. Under the tweezers are sesame-seed-sized parts that fly away with one tremor. Spending several days on one watch is normal, and impatient people struggle to sit still. Anyone curious about mechanical structures can become increasingly absorbed in the craft.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you enjoy restoring broken objects, watch repair offers a path where experience becomes more valuable with age and carries the prestige of craftsmanship.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Exceptional patience: able to spend several days repairing one watch
Close observation: notice tiny signs of wear
Integrity: treat customers honestly and quote repairs fairly

boundary_notice: 钟表维修最大的风险不是 AI，而是「学艺周期长 + 低端市场收缩」——熬得过寂寞、修得了复杂机芯的师傅，反而越来越稀缺、越来越值钱。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合手抖、毛躁、近视度数高又不戴矫正镜的人。掉一个零件在地上找半天是家常便饭，讨厌跟小东西较劲的人，这行会让你崩溃。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：钟表维修培训机构学基础（或拜师学徒）→ 从清洗保养入手练手 → 专攻石英表与常见机芯维修 → 进阶复杂机械机芯与古董表修复 → 进品牌售后或开自己的维修店。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合手稳、心细、有耐心的人。镊子底下是芝麻大的零件，手一抖就崩飞；一块表修几天是常态，急性子坐不住；对机械结构好奇的人，会越修越上瘾。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你享受「把坏东西修好」的过程，修表会给你一条越老越值钱、还带点匠人光环的路。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 手部稳定：镊子操作不抖
高度耐心：一块表修几天坐得住
观察细致：微小磨损看得见
机械思维：看得懂结构原理
诚信品质：不坑客人不乱报价
